name: tulay
description: Offline two-way Deaf <-> Blind communicator: 12 Filipino signs, local Whisper, phone-to-phone link.

scripts.start:lan: python3 scripts/build_manifest.py && python3 scripts/serve.py --lan --cert certs/cert.pem --key certs/key.pem
scripts.test:setup: cd test && npm install && npx playwright install chromium && bash make_media.sh
scripts.test: cd test && node e2e.mjs && node e2e-offline.mjs && node e2e-p2p.mjs
